title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Public Information Signs. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Public Information Signs
options.lineage: ISO 7001 / AIGA public-information pictograms and bilingual Saudi wayfinding plates
options.thesis: Rafiqi explained the way public buildings explain themselves: a pictogram, a destination, an arrow.
options.viewport: One big sign plate: the meeting-pin pictogram, رفيقي in heavy sign lettering, an arrow to download, the real app screen mounted beside it like a building directory.
options.risk: Turns municipal and cold if the pictograms look like clip art or the plates slide back into a card grid.

raised.raise: Every pictogram is drawn on one 48-unit grid at one stroke weight; no mixed icon library.
Absence is designed: steps not yet reached show as ghost plates, not dimmed text.
Category colour lives only inside its pictogram field, never in text or decoration.
Structure is the only ornament: the route line is the page's spine and its stops count the sections.
App blue appears only where something can be pressed or travelled.
Plates are ruled and framed, labels stacked Arabic over English like Saudi public signs.

options.label: Hospital Floor Lines
options.lineage: colour-coded guide lines painted on Saudi hospital and ministry floors
options.thesis: Follow the line: each kind of help is a coloured floor line leading to its own destination.
options.viewport: Coloured lines run in from the screen edge and converge at the meeting pin beside the headline.
options.risk: The most literal reading of 'route' and close to the current motif, so it can feel like a re-skin.

options.label: Queue Number Display
options.lineage: seven-segment displays: hospital queue boards, clocks, price totems
options.thesis: Your request number lights up like the queue board you watch at every appointment.
options.viewport: Request #481 in giant segments beside the headline.
options.case: Queue boards are familiar from hospital visits, but lit-on-black breaks the binding light theme and hurts clarity.
options.kept: Designed absence: unlit states drawn on purpose.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: The page as a friendly app screen.
options.viewport: Stacked cards with one bright action colour.
options.case: This is the card-grid look you flagged as AI-made.
options.kept: Action colour only where you can press.

options.label: Exposed Binding
options.thesis: Structure shown as the only ornament.
options.viewport: Sections stitched along a visible spine.
options.case: Beautiful but foreign to the audience; the thread metaphor blurs the meeting idea.

options.label: Anime Command Center
options.thesis: Every request as an alert on the big board.
options.viewport: A countdown wall with bilingual labels.
options.case: Alarm energy is wrong for calm companionship and breaks the light theme.

options.label: One-bit Desktop
options.thesis: The app as windows on a dithered desktop.
options.viewport: A window holding the request form.
options.case: Beneficiaries do not identify with it, and dithering hurts low vision.
options.kept: One drawing grammar for every icon.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud Edge
options.viewport: A white field with a thin colour fringe.
options.case: No link to companionship or getting around.
options.kept: Colour confined to its own band.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A mobile-app landing page executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and phone mockup, then a feature grid, steps and a download band.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every app landing page by design.
